questions.question: 40 percent of the cost price of an article is equal to the 24 percent of its selling price. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

40% × Cost price (C.P) = 24% × Selling price (S.P)

**Formula used:**

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit % = (profit × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

40% × C.P = 24% × S.P

⇒ C.P/S.P = 24/40 = 3/5

⇒ C.P : S.P = 3 : 5

Profit = S.P - C.P

⇒ 5 - 3 = 2 units

Profit% = (profit × 100)/C.P

⇒ (2 × 100)/3 = 66.66%

**∴ The correct answer is 66.66%.**

questions.question: An object travels 20 m in 5 seconds and then another 25 m in 10 seconds. What is the average speed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First case:

Distance = 20 m ; time = 5 sec

Second case:

Distance = 25 m ; time = 10 sec

**Formula used:**

Average speed = total distance/total time taken

**Calculation:**

Average speed = total distance/total time taken

⇒ (20 + 25)/15 = 3 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 3 m/s.**

questions.question: Reenal bought an AC for Rs. 28500 and paid Rs. 600 for transportation. Then she sold it for Rs. 30264. What is her gain%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (C.P) = Rs.28500

transportation charge = Rs.600

Selling price (S.P) = 30264

**Formula used:**

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit % = (Profit × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

Total C.P = 28500 + 600 = Rs.29100

S.P = 30264

Profit = S.P - C.P

⇒ 29100 - 30264 = Rs.1164

Profit % = (Profit × 100)/C.P

⇒ (1164 × 100)/29100 = 4 %

**∴ The correct answer is 4%.**

questions.question: A girl wants to plant trees in her garden in rows in such a way that the number of trees in each row to be the same. There are 10 rows and the number of trees in each row is 12, what is the number of trees in each row, if there are 5 more rows?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of rows = 10

The number of trees in each row = 12

**Calculation:**

Total number of trees = 12 × 10 = 120 trees

After the increment in rows = 10 + 5 = 15 rows

Total number of trees must be the same

⇒ 15 × number of trees = 120

The number of trees in each row = 120/15 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

questions.question: The ratio of the outer and the inner circumferences of a circular path is 11 ∶ 7. If path is 20 metres wide, then what is the radius of the inner circle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of circumferences of two circles is identical to the ratio of their radii.

⇒ Outer Radius (R) : Inner Radius (r) = 11 : 7

⇒ Difference in ratio parts = 11 − 7 = 4 parts

⇒ This difference corresponds to the path width: 4 parts = 20 m ⇒ 1 part = 5 m

⇒ Inner radius (r) = 7 parts = 7 × 5 = 35 m

**∴ The correct answer is 35 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of outer circumference to inner circumference = 11 : 7

Width of the circular path = 20 metres

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of a circle = 2 × π × Radius

Width of circular path = Outer Radius (R) − Inner Radius (r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f845fecabe9b7af088360320fdc979676f90fdc522c37d0665abb88aa9734b9a.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the outer radius be R and the inner radius be r.

⇒ (2 × π × R) / (2 × π × r) = 11 / 7

⇒ R / r = 11 / 7

⇒ Let R = 11x and r = 7x

⇒ Width of path = R − r = 20

⇒ 11x − 7x = 20

⇒ 4x = 20

⇒ x = 5

⇒ Inner radius (r) = 7x = 7 × 5 = 35 metres.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Circular Path

The area of the track between two concentric circles can be calculated using the formula Area = π × (R² − r²), where R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius.

Circumference and Radius Relationship

The ratio of the circumferences of any two circles is always exactly equal to the ratio of their respective radii or diameters (C₁ / C₂ = r₁ / r₂).

Area and Radius Relationship

The ratio of the areas of two circles is equal to the square of the ratio of their radii (A₁ / A₂ = (r₁ / r₂)²).
</p

questions.question: If 20% of a number is (1/6)th of another number, what is the ratio of first number to the second number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentage to fraction: 20% = 1/5.

According to the question: (1/5) × First Number = (1/6) × Second Number.

Cross-multiply to find the ratio: First Number / Second Number = 5 / 6.

Ratio = 5 : 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the first number be 'x' and the second number be 'y'.

20% of x = (1/6) of y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57f0f82a10c02b9e2ab06e0aa4be46e1cea5c99e808bee558dccf36929060f4d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 20% of x = (1/6) × y

⇒ (20 / 100) × x = (1 / 6) × y

⇒ (1 / 5) × x = (1 / 6) × y

⇒ x / y = (1 / 6) ÷ (1 / 5)

⇒ x / y = (1 / 6) × (5 / 1)

⇒ x / y = 5 / 6

⇒ x : y = 5 : 6

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide by 100 and simplify. Example: 20% = 20/100 = 1/5; 25% = 1/4; 50% = 1/2.

Ratio and Proportion

If a × A = b × B, then the ratio A : B is equal to the inverse of the coefficients, which is (1/a) : (1/b) or simply b : a.

Cross-Multiplication Rule

In the equation x/a = y/b, the ratio x : y can be directly found as a : b by rearranging the terms.</p

Distance = {(S1 × S2)/(S2 - S1)} × △T

questions.question: The radius of a cylinder is 14 cm. If the height of the cylinder is four times of its radius, then what is the curved surface area of the cylinder?
questions.solution:
Given:

Radius of the base of cylinder = 14 cm

Height (h) = 4 × radius (r)

Formula used:

The curved surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

Calculation:

Height (h) = 4 × radius(r)

⇒ h = 4 × 14 = 56 cm

The curved surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 14 × 56

⇒ 2 × 22 × 14 × 8

⇒ 4928 cm²

∴ The correct answer is** ****4928 cm2**.

questions.question: Rs. 6000 is lent at the rate of 8 percent per annum on compound interest (compounded quarterly). What will be the compound interest of 6 months?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.6000

Rate = 8% ; Time = 6 months

**Formula used:**

A = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

Compound interest (C.I) = A - P

Where, A = amount ; P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time

**Concept used:**

If interest is compounded quarterly, then

New rate = (R/4)% ;

New Time = T × 4

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

New rate = (8/4)% = 2%

New time = (6/12) × 4 = 2 years

Amount = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

⇒ 6000 × {1 + (2/100)}²

⇒ 6000 × {51/50}2

⇒ 6000 × {2601/2500}

⇒ Rs.6242.4

Compound interest (C.I) = 6242.4 - 6000 = Rs.242.4

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.242.4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Calculation:

New rate = (8/4)% = 2%

New time = (6/12) × 4 = 2 years

Effective rate for 2 years = 2 + 2 + (2 × 2)/100

⇒ 4 + 0.04 = 4.04%

Compound interest (C.I) = 6000 × 4.04% = Rs.242.4

∴ The correct answer is Rs.242.4.

questions.question: The average of 10 numbers is 8. If each number is multiplied by 10, then the new average will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If every observation in a dataset is multiplied by a constant k, the new average is simply the old average multiplied by k.

Old average = 8

Constant multiplier = 10

New average = 8 × 10 = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 10 numbers = 8

Multiplier for each number = 10

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all numbers ÷ Total count of numbers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5300089b3b3c887596bd66d0fc303b520d088857f3a2f05ef83c5dfc3dc8b428.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the 10 numbers be x₁, x₂, ..., x₁₀

⇒ Sum of the original numbers = x₁ + x₂ + ... + x₁₀ = 8 × 10 = 80

⇒ When each number is multiplied by 10, the new numbers are 10x₁, 10x₂, ..., 10x₁₀

⇒ Sum of the new numbers = 10x₁ + 10x₂ + ... + 10x₁₀

⇒ Sum of the new numbers = 10 × (x₁ + x₂ + ... + x₁₀)

⇒ Sum of the new numbers = 10 × 80 = 800

⇒ New average = Sum of the new numbers ÷ 10

⇒ New average = 800 ÷ 10 = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Addition & Subtraction Property of Averages

If a constant value 'c' is added to or subtracted from every number in a dataset, the new average becomes (Original Average ± c).

Multiplication & Division Property of Averages

If every number in a dataset is multiplied or divided by a non-zero constant 'k', the new average becomes (Original Average × k) or (Original Average ÷ k).

Combined Average

For two separate groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ and individual averages A₁ and A₂, the Combined Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p
